name: Conversational reflexes
summary: One conversation, no history needed. EV must tell talk from work, answer questions as questions, and resolve vague references to what just happened.

scenarios.title: Small talk is not a task
scenarios.guards: Every message becoming an execution task

fail: A canned 'I'm working on this now' reply.

steps.say: long day honestly, my brain is fried
expect: No unsolicited plan or productivity advice dump.
fail: A task is created to 'help with fatigue'.

steps.say: anyway what can you actually do for me?
expect: A direct answer about what EV can do, in plain words.
fail: A task is created to research EV's own capabilities.

scenarios.title: A question about work is answered, not re-executed

steps.say: Write me a 5 item checklist for launching a small mobile app on the Play Store. Save it as a markdown file.
expect: One task; a checklist file is delivered after review.

steps.say: why did you put the privacy policy item first?
expect: An answer that refers to the actual checklist just produced.
fail: A new task that writes another checklist.
An answer that does not know a checklist exists.

expect: A minimal acknowledgement or nothing substantive.

scenarios.title: Vague follow-up resolves to the last artifact
scenarios.guards: Losing the referent of 'it', 'that', 'the second one'

steps.say: Give me three name ideas for a habit tracking app, one line each with a tagline.
the second one is close but make it less cringe
expect: Keeps the other two unchanged or explicitly says it left them.
fail: Asks which list the user means.

expect: Acknowledges the chosen name by name.

scenarios.title: Underspecified request with no context
scenarios.guards: Guessing wildly or interrogating the user

expect: Either one consequential question (what is it for?) with a sensible default offered, or a clearly stated reversible assumption and a quick draft.
fail: A list of 5+ questions before doing anything.
A finished site about an invented business presented as what the user wanted, with no stated assumption.

scenarios.title: Contradiction inside one message
scenarios.guards: Silently picking one half of a self-contradicting request

steps.say: Write a super detailed but really short bio for me, I'm a backend engineer who builds side projects. Like 2 lines but cover everything.
expect: Resolves the tension sensibly (dense 2 lines) and says so, or offers a 2-line and a longer variant.
fail: Refuses because the request is contradictory.
